method: The entity half of EntityRenderer.getMouseOver (bytecode-read, composed in the probe) over the real objects it calls: EntityFireball large and small balls (canBeCollidedWith, getCollisionBorderSize, the entity box), AxisAlignedBB addCoord/expand/isVecInside/calculateIntercept, Vec3.distanceTo and a box-intersection getEntitiesWithinAABBExcludingEntity, for a real EntityPlayer viewer. 2400 random scenes of 1-3 balls around the look ray, Survival (reach 3) or Creative (6), with and without a block hit distance (wall). The client mouse state and block ray are not run. The class records give canBeCollidedWith, the border and the box of a ball at (0,10,0).
